body: CHIEF VOCABULARY AND SCOPE DECISION for bd-01M19956MFSG7076QE4J66T7E9. Approve public SupportAssessment with three disjoint meanings: Assessed carries the finite bounded share plus a nonempty eligible-term set; Unestablished carries a dedicated SupportUnestablishedReason; NotApplicable carries a dedicated SupportNotApplicableReason. Only Assessed exposes numeric comparison. Do not reuse features.UndefinedReason.ZeroTotalWeight: feature reduction and alignment-support establishment are different estimands. Required unestablished reasons distinguish EmptyEligibility from ZeroEligibleWeight. Required not-applicable reasons distinguish ExternalState from Unreachable. Joined-case construction must be checked and unforgeable; the factory computes/validates the share and eligibility relation rather than accepting a caller's status label. Advance wire to hsmm/v4 with no silent v3 migration. Add a real committed v4 byte/checksum court; retain v3 byte-identical as an explicit unsupported-schema/refusal fixture. Exact authorized surface is the twelve preflight-clear paths named in the assignment message. This is upstream of V1/E0 publication and does not widen the code-red graph.
